meta_description: Hear the note and find it on the violin fingerboard, starting from where your hand is.
title: Find the note by ear
subtitle: Hear the note and find it on the fingerboard, starting from where your hand is — like when you slip in the middle of a piece and need to catch the note ahead.

mic.label: Play the violin
mic.title: Coming soon: play your violin and the app listens through the microphone

dist.label: Distance from the current note
hints: The next note is within two scale degrees: almost always a neighbour.
Leaps of up to a fifth, up or down.
Any note in 1st position, up to an octave away.

notes.label: Notes
hints: Only the seven notes of the key.
Now and then, a note outside the scale (chromatic).

key.label: Key
hints: One major key per round — up to 2 accidentals at the Beginner level.

ctx.label: Context
hints: Plays the tonic before the first note.
Plays 1-2-3-4-5-3-1 of the scale so you can “get into the music”.
No context: only the starting note and the target.

hint.label: Direction hint
hints: After a miss: “higher ▲” or “lower ▼” — without saying the distance.

tries.label: Attempts per note
hints: After the 3rd, the game reveals the answer and counts it as a miss.
Keep trying until you find it; the average of attempts still counts.

staff.label: Show staff
hints: Pure ear training: nothing to read.
Shows the starting note on the staff; the target appears after you get it.

off.title: This exercise needs sound
off.text: Echo plays the note and you find it by ear — without seeing its name. Turn the sound on to start.

loading.title: Getting the sound ready…
loading.text: Just a moment: we are loading the violin sounds.

error.title: Could not turn the sound on
error.text: Check that the browser allows audio on this page and that the device is not in silent mode.

gate.hint: Use headphones or the speaker at a comfortable volume.

live.target_text: listen closely: it is the note that comes after {from}
live.here_text: this is where your hand is: {from} — compare it with the target
live.search_text: tap the fingerboard — every fret sounds

msg.ready: Listen to the context, then to the note. Without seeing its name.
msg.search: Find on the fingerboard the note you heard.
msg.search_sub: starting from {note} · every tap sounds, compare it with the target
msg.nohint: Not yet. Hear the target again and compare.
msg.wrong_sub: you played the fret marked with ✕ · attempt {n}
msg.reveal: It was {note} — {place}. Listen again and compare.

degree.out: outside the scale of {key}, between degrees {lo} and {hi}

board.hint: 1st position · only the pitch counts: the same sound on another string is also right
board.cols: 1st column = open string · then frets in half steps

staff.aria: Staff with the starting note and the target note

summary.hard_none: None — all on the first try.
